Qualcosa online ti fa stare male? Si può: Is something online hurting you? It can be stopped.
Insulti, ricatti, foto diffuse, minacce:: Insults, blackmail, shared photos, threats: it happens to many people and it is not your fault. Here you will find what to do right away, how to keep evidence and who can help you. Many services are free and answer at any time.

Questa pagina è in revisione da parte di: This page is being reviewed by experts in listening services and child protection. The numbers and services are checked against official sources, shown next to each one.
Cosa fare, passo per passo: What to do, step by step
Scegli chi sei: i consigli cambiano se s: Choose who you are: the advice changes if it is happening to you, if you see it happening, if you are a parent or a teacher.
Respira. Hai già fatto la cosa più diffi: Breathe. You have already done the hardest part: looking for help.
Don’t reply and don’t get even. A reaction is exactly what the person attacking you wants.
<strong>Salva le prove:</strong> una sch: Keep the evidence: a screenshot showing who wrote, the message, the date and the time. Copy the link too.
<strong>Blocca e segnala</strong> l’acco: Block and report the account on the platform: app, social network or game.
<strong>Parlane con un adulto di cui ti: Talk to an adult you trust: a parent, a teacher, your school’s cyberbullying contact person.
Se vuoi parlarne con qualcuno di esterno: If you want to talk to someone outside, call 114 or 1.96.96 (in Italy), at any time. 1.96.96 also answers by chat.
Rispondere con insulti o minacce: divent: Replying with insults or threats: it makes it harder to defend you.
Cancellare i messaggi: servono come prov: Deleting the messages: they are evidence.
Restare in silenzio sperando che passi d: Staying silent and hoping it will go away on its own.
Se qualcuno ti ricatta con foto o video: If someone is blackmailing you with intimate photos or videos
<strong>Non pagare e non mandare altro:<: Don’t pay and don’t send anything else: blackmailers usually don’t stop.
Interrompi la conversazione, ma non canc: Stop the conversation, but don’t delete it: it is evidence.
Segnala alla <a href=\"https://www.commi: Report it to the Polizia Postale (the Italian police for online crime) and ask an adult for help.
Dai 14 anni puoi chiedere da solo al <a: From the age of 14 you can ask the Italian Data Protection Authority yourself to stop the images from being shared, even before it happens.
<strong>Non è colpa tua:</strong> chi ri: It is not your fault: blackmail is a crime.
Se lo vedi succedere a qualcun altro: If you see it happening to someone else
Chi guarda può cambiare le cose. A volte: Bystanders can change things. Sometimes one person who refuses to play along is enough.
<strong>Non mettere like, non commentare: Don’t like, don’t comment, don’t forward. Even a like makes the attacker feel stronger.
<strong>Scrivi in privato a chi viene pr: Message the person being targeted privately: “I saw it. I’m sorry. I’m here.”
<strong>Avvisa un adulto di cui ti fidi<: Tell an adult you trust or the school’s contact person. It isn’t snitching: it’s protecting someone.
Laughing or sharing it “as a joke”.
Pensare «tanto ci penserà qualcun altro»: Thinking “someone else will deal with it”.
Affrontare da solo chi attacca, online o: Confronting the attacker on your own, online or in person.
Se succede a tuo figlio o a tua figlia: If it’s happening to your child
La cosa più importante è che continui a: The most important thing is that they keep talking to you. How you react now decides whether they will come to you next time too.
Non indicano per forza cyberbullismo, ma: They don’t necessarily mean cyberbullying, but they deserve an extra question:
usa il telefono di nascosto, oppure all’: they use their phone in secret, or suddenly avoid it;
si chiude, non vuole andare a scuola o a: they withdraw, or don’t want to go to school or to practice;
dorme male, è irritabile, ha spesso mal: they sleep badly, are irritable, often have stomach aches or headaches;
they stop seeing their usual friends.
<strong>Ascolta senza giudicare e senza: Listen without judging or interrupting. A sentence that helps: “You did the right thing telling me.”
<strong>Non togliere il telefono per pun: Don’t take the phone away as a punishment: it would teach them to stop telling you things.
<strong>Salvate le prove insieme:</stron: Keep the evidence together: screenshots with name, date and time, and the links.
<strong>Contatta il referente per il cyb: Contact the cyberbullying contact person at the school: in Italy every school must have one.
<strong>Segnala alla piattaforma.</stron: Report it to the platform. For threats, blackmail or intimate photos, go to the Polizia Postale.
Puoi chiedere tu la rimozione dei conten: You can ask for the content to be removed; from the age of 14 your child can also do it on their own.
Affrontare online l’altro ragazzo o i su: Confronting the other young person or their parents online.
Playing it down: “kids will be kids”.
Dare la colpa a tuo figlio per le foto o: Blaming your child for the photos or messages they sent.
Se succede nella tua classe: If it’s happening in your class
La legge chiede alla scuola di interveni: Italian law requires the school to act and gives it the tools to do so.
<strong>Accogli chi chiede aiuto</strong: Make time for the student who asks for help in private, not in front of the class.
<strong>Avvisa il referente</strong> per: Tell the contact person for bullying and cyberbullying and follow the school’s rules.
Il dirigente <strong>informa le famiglie: The head teacher informs the families of the minors involved, unless the act is a crime.
Nei casi più gravi o ripetuti la scuola: In the most serious or repeated cases the school turns to the relevant authorities.
Per formarti: la <a href=\"https://www.p: For training: the Ministry’s Piattaforma ELISA has courses for contact persons and teachers.
Handling the case on your own.
Discussing it in front of the whole class.
Chiedere a chi è colpito di «chiarire» c: Asking the targeted student to “sort it out” with the attacker.
Le prove: come salvarle bene: Evidence: how to keep it properly
Una buona prova si capisce anche da chi: Good evidence makes sense even to someone who wasn’t there. Three things are enough.
<strong>Una schermata completa:</strong>: A complete screenshot: it must show who wrote, the message, the date and the time.
<strong>Il link</strong> del profilo o d: The link to the profile or post: press and hold, then choose “Copy link”.
<strong>Una copia al sicuro:</strong> me: A safe copy: put everything in a folder and, if you can, send it to an adult you trust.
Foto o video intimi di minorenni: mai sa: Intimate photos or videos of minors: never save them, never forward them
Nemmeno come prova. Annota dove si trova: Not even as evidence. Note where they are (the link) and report them to the Polizia Postale or, anonymously, to Save the Children’s Stop-It.
La legge italiana dà strumenti anche ai: Italian law gives tools to young people too, not only to adults.
Dai 14 anni, o tramite un genitore, chie: From the age of 14, or through a parent, ask the website or social network to hide or remove it. If it doesn’t reply within 24 hours and doesn’t remove it within 48, write to the Data Protection Authority, which acts within 48 hours.
Legge 71/2017, art. 2 · <a href=\"https:: Law 71/2017, art. 2 · summary by the Children’s Ombudsman
Fermare le foto intime prima che girino: Stopping intimate photos before they spread
Se temi che qualcuno pubblichi tue foto: If you fear that someone will post intimate photos or videos of you, you can report it to the Data Protection Authority, from the age of 14 too. It decides within 48 hours and sends platforms only the file’s digital fingerprint.
Codice privacy, art. 144-bis · <a href=\: Italian Privacy Code, art. 144-bis · Data Protection Authority
Chi ha più di 14 anni e fa cyberbullismo: Anyone over 14 who cyberbullies can be summoned by the police chief (questore) together with a parent and formally warned to stop. The effects end at 18.
Legge 71/2017, art. 7 · <a href=\"https:: Law 71/2017, art. 7 · summary by the Children’s Ombudsman
Ogni scuola ha un referente per il bulli: Every school has a contact person for bullying and cyberbullying. A head teacher who learns of a case must promptly inform the families of the minors involved.
Legge 71/2017, artt. 4 e 5 · <a href=\"h: Law 71/2017, arts. 4 and 5 · Law 70/2024, summary
Servizi veri, con la fonte da cui li abb: Real services, with the source we checked them against. Calling doesn’t commit you to anything: you can just ask for advice.
